args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score BETWEEN 
    (SELECT m1.avg - 3 * m1.stddev 
     FROM (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as avg, 
                  SQRT((SUM(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) / COUNT(cognitive_score) - (AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score))) ) as stddev 
           FROM measurements) m1)
AND 
    (SELECT m2.avg + 3 * m2.stddev 
     FROM (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as avg, 
                  SQRT((SUM(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) / COUNT(cognitive_score) - (AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score))) ) as stddev 
           FROM measurements) m2);
